calculation.description: Ranks recent five-session losers more highly, but scales the reversal by trailing realized volatility so a given move is measured relative to the instrument's own noise.
calculation.timing: computed after the previous completed daily close; applied to the next session

validation.regime_notes: The one-observation horizon clears both benchmark admission gates across 1,670 daily cross-sectional observations, averaging 14.54 valid instruments. Annual mean IC was positive in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025, but slightly negative in 2026; longer-horizon decay is weak and reverses by 10 observations. Interpret conservatively given the 15-asset universe.

provenance.ic_method: daily Spearman cross-sectional correlation; minimum 8 valid assets
provenance.library_correlation_note: Not computed in this cycle; deterministic post-Miner audit must recompute pairwise correlation from signal artifacts.
